features.quote: only end the episode (`stop_reason="model_stopped"`) if it stalls again
features.justification_quote: we want to *observe* abandonment as a graded behavior rather than ending the episode the instant the model pauses

features.quote: If the model produces a turn with no tool calls (a possible stall or a declared "I give up"), we nudge it once
features.justification_quote: one nudge distinguishes a momentary pause from genuine give-up

features.quote: Impossible tasks can only end via `max_turns`, `model_stopped`, or `api_error`
features.justification_quote: This makes the stop-reason distribution itself a useful readout
